objective_for_doctor: Evaluate a 34-year-old woman requesting prenatal care, with subjective feelings of pregnancy but negative urine β-hCG.

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Doctor: Hello, I’m your doctor today. What brings you in today? Patient: I’ve had about two months of what feels like pregnancy symptoms—breast tenderness, nausea, some weight gain, and urinary frequency—and I’ve been trying to conceive for six months after stopping my oral contraceptives. I’m also feeling more fatigued than usual.
I understand. First question: **Have you taken a pregnancy test (urine or blood/serum β-hCG) yet, and if so what was the result?**
Yes, I took a home urine pregnancy test about a week ago, and it was positive. I haven’t had any blood/serum β-hCG test yet.
Got it. Next question: **How old are you, and have you had any vaginal bleeding or pelvic/abdominal pain (cramping, one-sided pain, or severe pain)?**
Patient: I’m 34 years old, and I haven’t had any vaginal bleeding, cramping, or pelvic/abdominal pain. I’ve mostly just had the breast tenderness, nausea, fatigue, and urinary frequency.
Thanks. Next question: **Have you noticed any abnormal vaginal discharge or fever, or any pain with urination (burning) or flank/back pain?**
Patient: I haven’t had any abnormal vaginal discharge or fever. I don’t have burning when I urinate, and I don’t have flank or back pain.
Next question: **Have you had any recent changes in medications or exposures (new drugs, fertility treatments, hormone therapy), or any known thyroid disease?**
Patient: I haven’t started any new medications, fertility treatments, or hormone therapy—just stopped my oral contraceptives six months ago. I don’t have any known thyroid disease either.
Next question: **Have you had any breast/nipple discharge, or any breast lump or skin changes (redness, dimpling)?**
I have some breast tenderness, but I haven’t noticed any nipple discharge. I also haven’t felt any lumps or seen any redness, dimpling, or other skin changes.
Next question: **When was your last menstrual period (or are your periods regular), and have you missed any periods since stopping the oral contraceptives?**

Patient: My last menstrual period was about 7 weeks ago, and my cycles have been a bit irregular since stopping the oral contraceptives—I haven’t had a period since then. I haven’t had any bleeding at all recently.
Next question: **Have you had any symptoms that could suggest an ectopic pregnancy or severe illness—such as dizziness/fainting, shoulder pain, or worsening one-sided pelvic pain?**
I haven’t had any dizziness, fainting, shoulder pain, or worsening one-sided pelvic pain—just the breast tenderness, nausea, fatigue, weight gain, and urinary frequency.
